verdict.rationale: Airbyte's materials only glance at AI-oriented delivery. It claims to connect systems to "inference" layers (docs-51), says agents can "query, search, and act on your data" (docs-39, docs-6), and markets PyAirbyte to AI developers, with data loaded into caches (docs-1, docs-47). Nothing in the pack documents loading synced data into vector stores or LLM-ready formats. missing for 10: documented vector-store destinations (e.g. Pinecone/Weaviate-type connectors), chunking/embedding or LLM-ready output formats, evidence that agents retrieve the synced data specifically, independent hands-on corroboration.
